programme.title: New Jack City (1991)
programme.desc: Streetwise cops target a megalomaniacal drug lord, whose empire is threatened by an informer.

programme.title: The Last Manhunt (2022)
programme.desc: In 1909, Willie Boy and his love Carlota go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers seeking justice for their "murdered" tribal leader.

programme.title: Ain't Them Bodies Saints (2013)
programme.desc: In 1970s Texas, a notorious outlaw claims responsibility for his wife's murder of a police officer. Years later, he attempts to break out of prison to reunite with his beloved and their daughter.

programme.title: Snake Eyes (1998)
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars in this highly stylized 1998 thriller directed by Brain De Palma. Cage plays a crooked cop investigating the assassination of the Secretary of Defense, who was shot at a championship boxing match in Atlantic City. As the investigation proceeds, he is forced to realizes that one of his closest friends (Gary Sinise), a Navy commander, may have been involved.

programme.title: Red (2010)
programme.desc: Retired CIA hit man Frank Moses and his former colleagues race to find out why they've been targeted for death by their former organisation and uncover a vast conspiracy implicating some prominent politicians in the process.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones (2009)
programme.desc: After young teenager Susie Salmon is murdered, she watches over her grieving parents, as well as her unapprehended killer, from a heaven of her own creation. Susie must come to terms with her own death, while sharing the pain her father and mother are working through.

programme.title: Love and Other Impossible Pursuits (2009)
programme.desc: Jack leaves his wife for Emilia, only to find his new marriage marked by tragedy. His son William seems intent on making Emilia's life miserable, and their union takes a sharp turn for the worse when their newborn baby dies suddenly.

programme.title: Wolves (2016)
programme.desc: In this richly nuanced coming-of-age drama, a high-school basketball star named Anthony seems to have a promising future ahead of him, but it's threatened by his father's severe gambling addiction. As Anthony pursues an athletic scholarship at Cornell, his dad gets tangled up with the mob.

programme.title: 45 Years (2015)
programme.desc: An ageing couple's marriage is challenged when the body of the husband's ex-fiancée is discovered, more than 50 years after she disappeared during a holiday in Switzerland.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County (2023)
programme.desc: At a middle-of-nowhere truck stop in Arizona, lives will collide as a traveling knife salesman gets caught up in a hostage situation. A pair of violent bank robbers are stranded with the salesman waiting for a gas truck. When the town's residents gather in the local diner, things get a little crazy as they realize the robbers are there, along with the money they stole.

programme.title: The Firm (1993)
programme.desc: A young lawyer discovers the firm he's hired into is controlled by the mob and attempts to escape from their clutches.

programme.title: Lions for Lambs (2007)
programme.desc: A powerhouse cast led by Robert Redford, Meryl Streep and Tom Cruise stars in this compelling examination of the U.S. war on terror, intercutting the stories of a liberal professor, a hawkish U.S. senator and a skeptical journalist. Michael Pena, Andrew Garfield, Peter Berg, Kevin Dunn.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky (2001)
programme.desc: Tom Cruise plays a thirtysomething heir to a publishing fortune who finds his life turned upside down after a car accident.

programme.title: Limitless (2011)
programme.desc: Struggling author Eddie Morra overcomes his writer's block with a new drug that unlocks the full potential of his brain, and he forges a partnership with a businessman seeking to capitalise on his extraordinary skills. Meanwhile, some dangerous characters discover Eddie's secret and come gunning for his dwindling supply of the pharmaceutical.

programme.title: Sound of Violence (2021)
programme.desc: As a child, the brutal murder of her family made Alexis regain her hearing along with synesthetic abilities. Now as an adult, she finds solace in the sounds of bodily harm. But when she's told she might lose her hearing again, she escalates her gruesome sound experiments in a quest to compose her masterpiece.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate (2019)
programme.desc: Two decades after the events of the first Terminator movie, an aging Sarah Connor joins forces with a cybernetically-enhanced female soldier from 2042?and her former nemesis, the T800?to protect a young girl from an advanced Terminator model from the dystopian future.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles (1974)
programme.desc: Mel Brooks' send-up of Hollywood Westerns.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn (1995)
programme.desc: A bloodsucker pursues an NYPD detective who has no idea she's the half-undead, half-human member of a dying tribe of vampires.

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult (1994)
programme.desc: More inspired silliness finds Lt. Drebin coaxed out of retirement to take down Rocco the terrorist. After going undercover and assisting in a Shawshank style prison break, Drebin discovers Rocco has access to powerful explosives and his target is the Academy Awards ceremony.

programme.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear (1991)
programme.desc: Inept police lieutenant Frank Drebin is back at it in this sequel. While at a White House reception honoring him for shooting his 1000th drug dealer, Drebin becomes tied up in a conspiracy to replace President George Bush's energy advisor with a clone who will support the agenda of evil energy lobbyists.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988)
programme.desc: Wildly inept Los Angeles cop Frank Drebin tries to foil an assassination. Inspired by the 1982 TV series.

programme.title: Cursed (2005)
programme.desc: "Scream" director Wes Craven and writer Kevin Williamson reunite for this bloodcurdling chiller. It's the story of siblings (Christina Ricci, Jesse Eisenberg) who are bitten by a mysterious beast, then gradually turn into werewolves. Can they break the deadly curse? Scott Baio and Craig Kilborn have cameos. Joshua Jackson, Portia de Rossi, Shannon Elizabeth, Mya, Kristina Anapau.

programme.title: The Mexican (2001)
programme.desc: An inept criminal's girlfriend is kidnapped while he is in Mexico trying to pull off one final job.

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain (2020)
programme.desc: Based on the actual death of elderly African American ex-serviceman Kenneth Chamberlain Sr. whom a team of police officers killed during a welfare check on him. This drama unpacks the lead-up to the event and the truth about the conflict.

programme.title: Born to Be Blue (2015)
programme.desc: Jazzman Chet Baker must relearn his craft in the late '60s after his front teeth are knocked out during a mugging. As he strives to get his career back on track and overcome his heroin addiction, he receives support from his new girlfriend, an actress who was cast to play his lover in a movie about his life.

programme.title: Good Kill (2014)
programme.desc: A disillusioned drone pilot, who controls spy aircrafts hovering over the Middle East from a trailer in Las Vegas, begins to feel morally disconnected from his military orders.

programme.title: The Painter (2024)
programme.desc: Peter, an ex-CIA operative, reluctantly finds himself face-to-face with the past he tried to run from when he unexpectedly encounters an enigmatic young woman from his past. As he and the woman suddenly find themselves the target of both a ruthless assassin and a paramilitary black ops force, he easily taps back into the training that he thought he had forgotten for good.

programme.title: The Contractor (2022)
programme.desc: Ex-Marine James Harper takes up arms in a paramilitary unit after his involuntary discharge from the Special Forces leaves him scrambling to make ends meet for his family. On a covert mission abroad, Harper soon finds himself caught in a violent feud, forcing him to find a way home by any means necessary.

programme.title: Hell or High Water (2016)
programme.desc: Two desperate brothers commit a string of bank robberies in order to raise the money needed to protect their family farm from foreclosure. Meanwhile, an aging sheriff tracks the heists in an attempt to hunt down those responsible.

programme.title: The Mexican (2001)
programme.desc: An inept criminal's girlfriend is kidnapped while he is in Mexico trying to pull off one final job.

programme.title: Dark Asset (2023)
programme.desc: When he glimpses a beautiful and enigmatic young woman from across the bar, a smooth and charming man attempts to flirt with her by telling her a story. As he spins his yarn of double agents, experimental microchip technology, and an unhinged military science organization on his trail in startling detail, the woman begins to wonder how much of the tale is fiction and how much is fact.

programme.title: The Mist (2007)
programme.desc: Survivors are trapped in a supermarket after a strange mist wipes out much of their town. In order to get out of the dire situation alive, they are forced to fend off a wave of deadly creatures.

programme.title: The Lovers (2015)
programme.desc: A marine archaeologist slips into a coma, and goes on an epic journey across four centuries while exploring his undying love for a woman in this sweeping romance.

programme.title: The Space Between Us (2017)
programme.desc: The first human born on Mars begins an online romance with a teenage girl in Colorado and hatches a plan to visit her.

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides (1999)
programme.desc: A moody memory piece about five doomed teenage sisters in 1970s suburbia.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity (2016)
programme.desc: The life of mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan is detailed in this biopic. Despite opposition in the forms of early-life poverty and constant racism, he became one of the most important and revolutionary pioneers in his field.

programme.title: Cracks (2011)
programme.desc: In this explosive drama, an unconventional teacher (Eva Green) at a private school for girls in England in the 1930s strikes up a controversial relationship with a free-spirited Spanish student (Maria Valverde). The directorial debut of Jordan Scott, daughter of filmmaker Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Crisis (2020)
programme.desc: Crisis presents three stories set against the backdrop of the opioid epidemic: an architect recovering from an addiction investigates the truth behind her son's disappearance and connection to narcotics; a professor employed by a pharmaceutical company wrestles with unexpected revelations about the true nature of his employer; and a drug peddler who arranges a multi-cartel operation across Canada and the United States.

programme.title: Patriots Day (2016)
programme.desc: Docudrama about the 2013 Boston Marathon bombing and subsequent manhunt.

programme.title: The Great Debaters (2007)
programme.desc: Denzel Washington directed and stars in this inspiring and uplifting true story, which chronicles the rise of a debate team at a small all-black college in Texas that went on to challenge Harvard in the 1930s.

programme.title: The Mist (2007)
programme.desc: Survivors are trapped in a supermarket after a strange mist wipes out much of their town. In order to get out of the dire situation alive, they are forced to fend off a wave of deadly creatures.

programme.title: The Collector (2009)
programme.desc: Ex-con Arkin (Josh Stewart) matches wits with a masked serial killer known as "The Collector" in this suspenseful shocker. Arkin decides to rob a country manor but finds that its occupants have been taken hostage inside their home by "The Collector." Now Arkin is the family's only hope for survival as he does battle with the sadist and his lethal booby traps. Directed by Marcus Dunstan.

programme.title: Project Almanac (2014)
programme.desc: A teenager prospers after discovering a way to time travel, but doesn't understand the ramifications of what he's done until it's too late.

programme.title: The Ring (2002)
programme.desc: Naomi Watts shines in this thriller about a reporter who investigates her niece's mysterious death, which seems to be linked to a videotape. Apparently, anyone who watches the tape dies horribly seven days later. Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander, Lindsay Frost, Amber Tamblyn.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky (2001)
programme.desc: Tom Cruise plays a thirtysomething heir to a publishing fortune who finds his life turned upside down after a car accident.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.desc: Winnipeg Jets at Dallas Stars in Game 6 of a Western Conference second-round series. From American Airlines Center. The Stars return to Texas still one win away from a conference finals rematch with Edmonton, having been blanked by Connor Hellebuyck in their last two games on Jets ice. Stars winger Mikko Rantanen remains the NHL playoff scoring leader with 19 points and nine goals. Winnipeg is mired in a nine-game road losing streak in the playoffs.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.desc: St. Louis Blues vs. Winnipeg Jets in Game 7 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Canada Life Centre. The first-ever NHL Game 7 in Manitoba will send one of these teams into the second round, following six straights wins by the home team. St. Louis knotted the series with a 5-2 triumph two nights ago in which they chased Jets star goalie Connor Hellebuyck after two periods.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.desc: Carolina Hurricanes vs. New Jersey Devils in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Prudential Center. The 'Canes blow into Newark with a 2-0 series lead, built on two stellar performances by goaltender Frederik Andersen (1.00 GAA), as well as Jordan Martinook's electric shorthanded game-winning goal midway through Game 2. Carolina is 5-13 on the road the last three postseasons, with this series the sixth in that span against a team in the New York metro area.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.desc: New Jersey Devils vs. Carolina Hurricanes in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Lenovo Center. Seventh-year forward Andrei Svechnikov came alive with a hat trick in Game 4 as Carolina took a 3-1 series lead and now looks to extend its first-round home dominance under Rod Brind'Amour. Pyotr Kochetkov saw his first action in net for the Canes in relief of ailing Fred Andersen.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 1 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. Fourth-year star Cade Cunningham heads the Pistons' first playoff squad in six years, and averaged 30.8 points and 8.3 assists vs. New York this season as Detroit went 2-0 at MSG. Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns pace the Knicks in the teams' first playoff meeting since 1992.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. The Pistons try again to end their 15-game playoff losing streak after falling 123-112 in Game 1 in the Big Apple, crumbling by 40-21 in the fourth quarter. Jalen Brunson's 34 led New York, while Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby combined for nine steals, four blocks and 46 points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. J.B. Bickerstaff's Pistons return to the Motor City as playoff winners for the first time in 17 years following a 100-94 triumph in Game 2 that knotted the series at 1-1. Cade Cunningham piled up 33 points and 12 boards in the win, while Jalen Brunson's 37 went for naught.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. J.B. Bickerstaff's Pistons trail 2-1 in the series and are a loss away from matching the league record of nine for consecutive home playoff losses, set by the 76ers (1968-71). Karl-Anthony Towns (31 points) and Jalen Brunson (30) carried New York in a 118-116 Game 3 victory.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 6 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. The visitors have won four of five games in this series as New York takes a 3-2 edge back to Motown, where the Pistons have lost an NBA record-tying nine straight playoff games. Third-year center Jalen Duren had nine points, 14 boards and six assists in Detroit's 106-103 Game 5 win.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets in Game 1 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Ball Arena. Ty Lue's Clippers sail into the playoffs on an eight-game win streak, boasting the third-best FG pct. defense (39.5) in the league as they battle superstar Nikola Jokic, the third player ever to average a triple-double for an NBA season. Fellow Euro Ivica Zubac patrols the paint for L.A.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets in Game 2 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Ball Arena. Denver's Russell Westbrook stung his previous Clippers mates with late clutch play in a 112-110 Game 1 overtime win. Nikola Jokic chipped in three of the Nuggets' 11 steals, to go with a game-high 29 points and 12 assists. James Harden's 32 points topped L.A., which blew a 15-point lead.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Clippers in Game 4 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Intuit Dome. L.A. is up 2-1 in a best-of-seven that began with two nail-biting finishes in Denver before the Clippers sailed to a 117-83 Game 3 win in their raucous new home in Inglewood. Nic Batum had four of L.A.'s 18 made three-pointers, to just seven for the Nuggets.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Houston Rockets at Golden State Warriors in Game 4 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Chase Center. Steve Kerr's Warriors are up 2-1, halfway to their eighth first-round series win in the last eight tries. Steph Curry's 36 points and nine assists fueled a 104-93 win in Game 3 as Golden State weathered an early 13-point Rockets lead, and overcame 31-percent shooting from long range.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Golden State Warriors at Houston Rockets in Game 5 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Toyota Center. Steve Kerr's Warriors return to Texas with a 3-1 series edge, looking to close out the young Rockets who fell 109-106 in Game 4 despite eight threes from Fred VanVleet. Jimmy Butler's 27 points sparked Golden State in his return from injury, sinking 12-of-12 free throws.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Houston Rockets at Golden State Warriors in Game 6 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Chase Center. Steph Curry and the veteran Dubs take a second shot at closing out youthful Houston, which held serve in Game 5 with a 131-116 home win sparked by Amen Thompson's 25 points and five steals. Golden State's starters totaled just 40 points as the Rockets built a lead as big as 31.
